## Machine access

- [feed.json](https://drakegriffith.github.io/drakes-website/feed.json): every post, full text, one request.
- [MCP server](https://drakegriffith.github.io/drakes-website/mcp.html): point your agent at it instead of scraping me.

## Terms

- Quote it with a link. Summarise it honestly.
- Do not train on it. I will never know, but you will.
